messages:
Rachel Sun: hi all :wave: i'm rachel, started today on developer experience (she/her). moved here from denver, hybrid. hobby: brewing wild kombucha and collecting indie comics. excited to meet folks and trade recs!
Noah Green: welcome rachel!! :tada: kombucha club is a thing (lowkey). bring a SCOBY someday? also comics recs please 
Ava Li: hi rachel, welcome! we usually swap lunch recs and comic recs in #random. favorite genre?
Rachel Sun: @Ava i'm into slice-of-life and weird sci-fi anthologies. happy to trade scans and bring a small batch of ginger-kombucha for anyone who wants to taste-test.
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Rachel! Checklist: badge pickup, equipment form, HR intro. Links: <https://intranet/onboard|onboarding checklist>. Reply "help" for assistance.
Coffee Bot: If you want your kombucha paired with coffee, try a slow pour cortado after the second ferment. :coffee::yum:
Noah Green: comic swap + kombucha tasting = perfect midweek morale boost. also quick logistics: desk allocation is on the wiki, and there's a scooter parking rack outside east entrance.
Rachel Sun: thanks! question about scooter parking: is it first-come or assigned?
Ava Li: first-come, but facilities plans to add more racks next month.
Rachel Sun: great, i'll bring a tiny batch friday and a couple of comics to trade. see you then :smile:
Noah Green: count me in for kombucha testing. welcome aboard!
Ava Li: welcome rachel :heart:
